deviations: Reviewer round-1 blockers fixed: (1) reverse_tax_cost_adjustment computes the receipt/digest and returns the stored result before the already-reversed check, so same-token replay succeeds; (2) reversal now creates negative mirror SharedCostAllocationLine rows (same target/basis, allocated_cents negated) and tests assert the mirror. Required fixes: multi-project weight attribution (sum basis 10000, amount=tax), company-level no-lines case, RevenueRecognition/CashTransaction/OpenItem fact-count stability, future-date rejection, and a POOL_KINDS non-exhaustive note in the service (models.py is outside the PH-371 whitelist).

No new costing model/migration: PH-371 whitelist excludes models.py/migrations and the spec allows reusing existing costing cost-adjustment models. The adjustment is represented as an append-only SharedCostAllocationBatch (pool_kind=tax_not_recoverable) with optional project lines derived from invoice allocation contract-line projects; no new table/schema.

No verify_integrity branch: the PH-371 whitelist does not include core/management/commands/verify_integrity.py (spec says 'if whitelisted'); verify_integrity is unchanged and the adjustment is an append-only batch, not a ledger/period mutation. This is disclosed rather than self-expanding the whitelist.

The service writes no ledger/revenue/cash/open-item fact: it creates only the append-only costing batch/line/receipt plus plugin. audit, references the original tax qualification/invoice, and leaves invoicing facts untouched. Company-level adjustments without project attribution carry no project lines rather than inventing one.
Reversal is a separate negative append-only SharedCostAllocationBatch (kind=reversal) linked by reverses_batch, allowed once; it does not edit the original batch.
The tax adjustment amount uses the qualification tax_cents (ADR 0015 frozen amount); no FX/multi-currency extension or tax filing is implemented.
